nanu na dehasya sarvā avasthā duḥkharūpāstadbālyasya sarvajanaspṛhaṇīyatayā
ramyataratvāt tadyathā mahārājo vā mahābrāhmaṇo vā mahākumāro vā
atighnīmānandasya gatvā śayīta iti śrutyāpi bālyasyānandabahulatvaprati- labdhvāpīti

bālyaṃ kevalaṃ
duḥkhāyaiva labhate janturiti śeṣaḥ
tathāca śrutiḥ tato vai taddurniṣprapataram iti

puraḥsthitaṃ pratibimbamiva sphuṭaṃ ghanaṃ nibiḍaṃ ajñānaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ citte
tattadviṣayapratibimbanairvā ghanāni bahulāni bhrāntijñānāni yasmin
bhayaṃ lakṣaṇayā duḥkhaṃ mukhyameva vā bhayādapi bhayāntarotpatteḥ
na kevalaṃ manuṣyāṇāmevābhavyamapi tu sarvajantūnāmityāha - sarveṣāmiti

kadācidbhojanecchayā rudanbālo bhuvanaṃ te bhojanaṃ dāsyāmīti pratāraṇena
saṃhṛṣṭastadeva bhoktuṃ vāñchate vāñchatīti prasiddham

kasyāpi parituṣṭaye sukhāya alamatyarthe naiva
bhavatītyarthaḥ
